rules.cycle: One control, one action: each activation cycles system → light → dark → system. It never opens a picker of the three.
rules.controlled: Use value with onValueChange for a controlled mode, or defaultValue to seed the initial mode and stay uncontrolled.
rules.sync: Every ThemeToggle instance on the page reflects the same mode; an uncontrolled toggle listens for other instances cycling and updates itself.
rules.labels: The accessible name already states the current mode in English; pass labels to override per mode instead of adding visible text.
